text.p: Malawi President Bakili Muluzi announced a new cabinet on Thursday after the dissolving his old cabinet at the weekend as part of the government's civil service reform programme.
Foreign affairs minister George Ntafu was replaced by former agriculture minister Mapopa Chipeta, while health minister Ziliro Chibambo was replaced by former transport minister Harry Thompson.
Education minister Donton Mkandawire was replaced by former information minister Brown Mpinganjira.
He recalled the ruling party's secretary general and a former education minister Sam Mpasu to become information minister.
Muluzi appointed former surveys and physical planning minister Edda Chitalo and ex home affairs minister Robson Makuwira to the president's office.
Former finance minister Aleke Banda was relegated to the agriculture portfolio. Malawi's Vice President Justin Malewezi remains in the post.

Former minister of state, Joseph Kubwalo, was named defence minister, while former relief and rehabilitation minister Richard Sembereka, whose ministry was dissolved, was made the new national heritage minister.
Muluzi's cabinet comprises 24 ministers and 13 deputies with a former journalist and a president's speech writer as some of the new members.
